nodes.name: TreePlant.cs
nodes.summary: Abstract base class for choppable, seasonal trees. Trees take 5 axe hits (via Axe.IUseableWithAxe) then fall, swapping in a stump and fallen-tree prefab; they swap sprite and material by TreeStates season state (windy material for summer/fall, standard lit when dead), shake on chopping/gusts/bird landings, and act as a bird shelter target (BirdBrain.IShelterable).
nodes.languageNotes: Unity script with [SerializeField] protected inspector fields, ReactiveUnity Reactive<TreeStates> with OnChange subscriptions, DOTween DOShakePosition for chop shake, and coroutines (WaitUntil on the player's Axing state) for the falling animation timing.

nodes.name: TreeStates
nodes.summary: Seasonal adult states of a tree: SummerAdult, FallAdult, and DeadAdult.

nodes.name: TreePlant
nodes.summary: Abstract MonoBehaviour implementing InteractInput.IInteractable, Axe.IUseableWithAxe, and BirdBrain.IShelterable. Tracks a Reactive<TreeStates> state that drives sprite/material, survives 5 axe hits before spawning a stump + fallen tree and destroying itself, frightens perched birds when chopped, and provides a random perch target inside its bird-shelter collider.
nodes.languageNotes: Unity script with [SerializeField] protected inspector fields, ReactiveUnity Reactive<TreeStates> with OnChange subscriptions, and DOTween.

nodes.name: Awake
nodes.summary: Caches the SpriteRenderer and applies the current tree-state visuals via OnStateChange().
nodes.languageNotes: Unity script lifecycle method.

nodes.name: OnEnable
nodes.summary: Subscribes to the Reactive _treeState change event, routing any state change to OnStateChange().
nodes.languageNotes: ReactiveUnity OnChange subscription, unsubscribe action stored for OnDisable.

nodes.name: OnDisable
nodes.summary: Unsubscribes the stored Reactive change hook.
nodes.languageNotes: Unity script lifecycle method.

nodes.name: OnStateChange
nodes.summary: Swaps the SpriteRenderer's material and sprite based on TreeStates: windy material with summer/fall sprites, standard-lit material with the dead sprite.
nodes.languageNotes: ReactiveUnity OnChange callback pattern.

nodes.name: OnUseAxe
nodes.summary: Axe strike handler: increments _hitCount and frightens birds + shakes the tree until _HITS_TO_FALL (5) hits, then starts the FallTree coroutine.
nodes.languageNotes: Axe.IUseableWithAxe implementation; uses StartCoroutine for the fall sequence.

nodes.name: ShakeTree
nodes.summary: Plays a positional shake on the transform via DOTween DOShakePosition using the chop-shake duration, horizontal strength, vibrato, and randomness fields.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses DOTween's DOShakePosition with a Vector3 strength (X-only).

nodes.name: FallTree
nodes.summary: Waits for the player's axing animation to end, picks a fall side via WillTreeFallEast(), instantiates a stump and the east/west fallen-tree prefab under the Impermanent tag at offsets, disables the fallen tree's YDepthSorter and bumps its sorting order so it renders in front of the stump, then destroys this tree.
nodes.languageNotes: Coroutine using WaitUntil; Object.Instantiate with a parent from FindGameObjectWithTag("Impermanent"); GetComponentInChildren for YDepthSorter.

nodes.name: WillTreeFallEast
nodes.summary: Maps the player's CompassDirection to the tree's fall side — west-facing directions fall west, east-facing fall east, and north/south resolve randomly.
nodes.languageNotes: Switch on the player's Direction Reactive value.

nodes.name: CursorInteract
nodes.summary: InteractInput stub that always returns false — trees are only chopped with the axe, not cursor-interacted.

nodes.name: OnBirdEntry
nodes.summary: Adds an entering bird to _birdsInTree and shakes the tree when a bird first lands in it.
nodes.languageNotes: BirdBrain.IShelterable implementation; HashSet membership guard.

nodes.name: OnBirdExit
nodes.summary: Removes a departing bird from _birdsInTree and shakes the tree on departure.

nodes.name: GetPositionTarget
nodes.summary: Returns a random point inside the _birdShelterTarget collider's bounds — the perch target birds seek when taking shelter in the tree.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Bounds from a serialized Collider2D and UnityEngine.Random.Range.

nodes.name: FrightenBirds
nodes.summary: Calls FrightenBird() on every bird currently perched in the tree, used when the tree is chopped.

nodes.name: GetSortingOrder
nodes.summary: Returns the tree's SpriteRenderer sorting order so birds can layer on top of the tree.

nodes.name: WeightyObjectStackConfig.cs
nodes.summary: ScriptableObject config for a weighty-object container (e.g. a wheelbarrow): a weight capacity plus insert/remove SoundData for audio feedback.
nodes.languageNotes: [CreateAssetMenu] ScriptableObject data container with public fields; no logic.

nodes.name: WeightyObjectStackConfig
nodes.summary: ScriptableObject exposing WeightCapacity, InsertSound, and RemoveSound for weighty-object stacks like the wheelbarrow.
nodes.languageNotes: [CreateAssetMenu(fileName = "WeightyObjectContainerData", menuName = "Weighty/WeightyObjectContainerData")].

nodes.name: WheelBarrowContainedSprites.cs
nodes.summary: MonoBehaviour that mirrors a wheelbarrow's WeightyObjectStack contents onto its child SpriteRenderers, picking the north-south or east-west carry sprite based on the wheelbarrow's facing direction.
nodes.languageNotes: Unity script subscribing to a ReactiveUnity Reactive collection (StoredObjects.OnChange); uses UnityEngine.Assertions.Assert.IsTrue for dev checks.

nodes.name: WheelBarrowContainedRenderers
nodes.summary: On each StoredObjects change, activates one child per stored object and assigns the carried object's NSCarry or EWCarry sprite by facing direction, deactivating unused children.
nodes.languageNotes: Unity script with ReactiveUnity OnChange subscription and Assert.IsNotNull/IsTrue dev checks.

nodes.name: OnEnable
nodes.summary: Asserts the stack reference, subscribes to StoredObjects changes, and refreshes contained renderers once.
nodes.languageNotes: Unity lifecycle method; adds to a list of unsubscribe hooks.

nodes.name: OnDisable
nodes.summary: Runs and clears all stored Reactive unsubscribe hooks.
nodes.languageNotes: Unity lifecycle method.

nodes.name: UpdateContainedRenderers
nodes.summary: Iterates StoredObjects, enabling one child per object and assigning NSCarry or EWCarry sprites by _facingDirection, then hides leftover children. Asserts enough child GameObjects exist to display every contained object.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses transform.GetChild(i) + GetComponent<SpriteRenderer>().sprite.

nodes.name: WoodRack.cs
nodes.summary: Firewood storage rack holding wet and dry logs. Implements InteractInput.IInteractable, GameClock.ITickable, and SaveData.ISaveable: wet logs dry over in-game minutes (drying faster when the rack sits in a Warm/Hot heat zone), dry logs can be removed into the inventory, and the rack sprite swaps by fill level with narrator feedback.
nodes.languageNotes: Unity script with ReactiveUnity Reactive<int> log counts + OnChange subscriptions, GameClock.OnGameMinuteTick events, coroutine to delay narrator messages, and SaveData.ISaveable JSON persistence.

nodes.name: WoodRack
nodes.summary: MonoBehaviour firewood rack implementing InteractInput.IInteractable, GameClock.ITickable, SaveData.ISaveable. Tracks wet/dry log counts as Reactive<int>s, dries wet logs over game minutes (multiplied by _temperatureMultiplier in Warm/Hot zones via HeatSensitive), narrates when all logs dry, adds dry logs to the inventory, and saves/loads counts plus per-log timers.
nodes.languageNotes: Unity script with ReactiveUnity subscriptions and GameClock.ITickable minute-tick subscription; uses FindFirstObjectByType for PlayerEnergyManager.

nodes.name: WoodRackSaveData
nodes.summary: Nested serializable snapshot of rack state: wet log count, dry log count, and the per-log drying timers list.
nodes.languageNotes: Plain private data class serialized via SaveData.AddExtendedSaveData<T>().

nodes.name: OnEnable
nodes.summary: Caches PlayerEnergyManager, HeatSensitive, and SpriteRenderer; subscribes Reactive hooks for both log counts and the GameClock minute tick; seeds starting wet/dry logs; refreshes the rack sprite.
nodes.languageNotes: Unity lifecycle; FindFirstObjectByType + GameClock.Instance event subscription.

nodes.name: OnDisable
nodes.summary: Unsubscribes from the GameClock minute tick and runs/clears all Reactive unsubscribe hooks.
nodes.languageNotes: Unity lifecycle method.

nodes.name: PostAllLogsDryMessage
nodes.summary: Narrates 'All logs on the woodrack have dried out.' when the last wet log converts — immediately if the player is sleeping, otherwise deferred one frame via coroutine so the narrator has loaded.
nodes.languageNotes: ReactiveUnity OnChange(prev, curr) callback reading PlayerEnergyManager.IsPlayerSleeping.

nodes.name: WaitToPostMessage
nodes.summary: Waits a single frame then posts the given message through the Narrator.
nodes.languageNotes: Small coroutine using yield return null.

nodes.name: UpdateRackSprite
nodes.summary: Selects the rack sprite by total log count (dry + wet) from the serialized _rackSprites array.
nodes.languageNotes: ReactiveUnity OnChange callback; indexes array by sum of Reactive values.

nodes.name: OnGameMinuteTick
nodes.summary: Increments each wet log's drying timer every game minute (multiplied by _temperatureMultiplier when the rack's HeatSensitive temperature is Warm/Hot), then converts every timer that passed _timeToDryGameMins from wet to dry.
nodes.languageNotes: GameClock.ITickable; List.RemoveAll predicate to reap expired timers.

nodes.name: TryAddWetLog
nodes.summary: Adds a wet log (pushing a fresh drying timer) if the rack is not full.

nodes.name: IsRackFull
nodes.summary: Returns true and narrates 'the rack is full.' when wet + dry logs reach _rackLogCapacity.
nodes.languageNotes: Narrator.Instance.PostMessage for player feedback.

nodes.name: TryAddDryLog
nodes.summary: Adds a dry log directly if the rack is not full.

nodes.name: RemoveDryLog
nodes.summary: Removes one dry log into the inventory; does nothing on an empty rack and reports 'this wood is wet' (PlayerDialogue) when only wet logs remain.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Inventory.TryAddItem with the serialized _dryLog item.

nodes.name: CursorInteract
nodes.summary: InteractInput entry point that removes a dry log from the rack.

nodes.name: Save
nodes.summary: Builds a SaveData with identifier, transform position, and WoodRackSaveData extended data (wet/dry counts and drying timers).
nodes.languageNotes: SaveData.ISaveable pattern: AddIdentifier, AddTransformPosition, AddExtendedSaveData<T>.

nodes.name: Load
nodes.summary: Restores wet/dry log counts and the drying timers list from extended SaveData.
nodes.languageNotes: SaveData.GetExtendedSaveData<WoodRackSaveData>().

nodes.name: WoodStove.cs
nodes.summary: Stove with a fire state machine (Dead, Ready, Hot, Embers). Implements InteractInput.IInteractable, UseItemInput.IUsableTarget, GameClock.ITickable, and SaveData.ISaveable: firewood-loading and interaction drive state transitions, game minutes burn the fire Hot→Embers→Dead, and each state drives an Animator clip, LocalHeatSource (Warm), PulseLight intensity, and looping fire SFX.
nodes.languageNotes: Unity script with ReactiveUnity Reactive<FireStates> + OnChange subscription, GameClock.ITickable minute tick, and AudioManager.PlayLoopingSFX for fire audio.

nodes.name: WoodStove
nodes.summary: MonoBehaviour implementing InteractInput.IInteractable, UseItemInput.IUsableTarget, GameClock.ITickable, SaveData.ISaveable. Drives a Reactive<FireStates> machine: Ready is lit by interaction (Hot), firewood can be loaded when Dead (→Ready) or Embers (→Hot), game minutes advance Hot→Embers→Dead, and state changes replay Animator clips, toggle LocalHeatSource Warm heat and PulseLight, and start/stop looping fire SFX.
nodes.languageNotes: Unity script with ReactiveUnity subscription and GameClock minute tick; nested private enum + save-data class.

nodes.name: FireStates
nodes.summary: Private stove state machine states: Dead, Ready (fuel loaded, unlit), Hot, and Embers.

nodes.name: WoodStoveSaveData
nodes.summary: Nested serializable snapshot of stove state: the FireStates value and the fire-duration counter in game minutes.
nodes.languageNotes: Plain private data class serialized via SaveData.AddExtendedSaveData<T>().

nodes.name: OnEnable
nodes.summary: Caches Animator, LocalHeatSource, and PulseLight; subscribes a Reactive state hook and the GameClock minute tick; applies the initial state.
nodes.languageNotes: Unity lifecycle; GameClock.Instance.OnGameMinuteTick subscription.

nodes.name: OnDisable
nodes.summary: Stops any playing fire SFX, unsubscribes from the GameClock minute tick, and runs/clears Reactive hooks.
nodes.languageNotes: Unity lifecycle method.

nodes.name: OnGameMinuteTick
nodes.summary: Advances the fire each game minute: Hot transitions to Embers after _hotFireDurationGameMinutes, and Embers to Dead after hot + embers duration combined.
nodes.languageNotes: GameClock.ITickable; mutates Reactive _stoveState.Value to trigger OnStateChange.

nodes.name: OnStateChange
nodes.summary: Routes Reactive stove state changes to the matching EnterDead/EnterReady/EnterHot/EnterEmbers handler.
nodes.languageNotes: ReactiveUnity OnChange callback dispatch switch.

nodes.name: EnterHot
nodes.summary: Resets the duration counter, plays the HotFire animation at full speed, enables the heat source at Temperature.Warm, activates the fire light, and sets its flicker intensity to the fire range.
nodes.languageNotes: PulseLight.SetIntensity(min, max) drives the flicker.

nodes.name: EnterEmbers
nodes.summary: Stops the fire SFX, plays the Embers animation at 0.05 speed, keeps the Warm heat source on, and dims the PulseLight to the embers intensity range.

nodes.name: EnterDead
nodes.summary: Resets animation speed, plays a blank clip then the Dead clip (fixing scene-switch jank), and disables the heat source and fire light.
nodes.languageNotes: Animator.Play("") reset then Animator.Play("Dead").

nodes.name: EnterReady
nodes.summary: Plays the Ready animation with heat source and fire light off — stove is loaded and waiting to be lit.

nodes.name: CursorInteract
nodes.summary: InteractInput handler: narrates 'the stove is cold.' when Dead, or when Ready transitions to Hot, starts the fire SFX and narrates 'the room grows warm.'; otherwise refuses interaction.
nodes.languageNotes: Narrator.Instance.PostMessage for feedback.

nodes.name: AddFirewood
nodes.summary: UseItemInput target that loads fuel: Dead→Ready, Embers→Hot (restarting fire SFX), Hot just re-narrates 'you stoke the flames.'; refuses while already Ready. Always resets the duration counter.
nodes.languageNotes: Switch over Reactive _stoveState.Value.

nodes.name: Save
nodes.summary: Builds a SaveData with identifier, transform position, and WoodStoveSaveData extended state (FireStates value + fire duration counter).
nodes.languageNotes: SaveData.ISaveable pattern: AddIdentifier, AddTransformPosition, AddExtendedSaveData<T>.

nodes.name: Load
nodes.summary: Restores the stove state and fire duration counter from extended SaveData, restarting the fire SFX if the stove loads in the Hot state.
nodes.languageNotes: SaveData.GetExtendedSaveData<WoodStoveSaveData>().

nodes.name: StopFireSFX
nodes.summary: Stops the looping fire sound via the stored stop callback if one is active.
nodes.languageNotes: Stores the stop Action returned by AudioManager.PlayLoopingSFX.

nodes.name: StartFireSFX
nodes.summary: Starts a looping fire SFX through AudioManager.PlayLoopingSFX if fire sound data exists and no loop is already playing.
nodes.languageNotes: AudioManager.PlayLoopingSFX(_audioSource, _fireSound) returns a stop Action.

nodes.name: Wedges.hlsl
nodes.summary: HLSL include (Shader Graph Custom Function) providing two antialiased wedge-mask functions — a circular wedge fill and a UV wedge cutout — used by birding shaders to draw radial wedge shapes and angle-range masks.
nodes.languageNotes: Custom Function nodes for Unity Shader Graph; functions follow the _float suffix convention (inputs/outputs of float4 with out params). Uses atan2, fwidth/ddx/ddy for antialiased edges.

nodes.name: CircularWedge_float
nodes.summary: Outputs an antialiased mask for a circular wedge: radius check via distance with fwidth-based edge softening, plus an angle-range test (in radians, handling ranges that cross 0).
nodes.languageNotes: Uses atan2 for angle, fwidth(dist) for antialiasing, saturate for the edge gradient.

nodes.name: WedgeCutout_float
nodes.summary: Cuts a wedge out of a UV: builds an angular step mask for the angle range and antialiases the wedge edges using the ddx/ddy angular gradient, leaving the rest of the UV visible.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses step() for angle masks and abs(ddx(theta)) + abs(ddy(theta)) for angular antialiasing.

nodes.name: manifest.json
nodes.summary: Unity package manifest declaring project dependencies: Cinemachine 3.1.3 (camera), Unity Input System 1.18.0 (new input), URP 17.3.0 (2D rendering), 2D Animation 13.0.4, ugui 2.0.0, feature.2d 2.0.2, and the BlueOyster json-persistence-unity git package (ReactiveUnity + JSON save system). All standard com.unity.modules.* built-in modules are pinned to 1.0.0. DOTween is not here — it ships as a vendored package under Assets/.

nodes.name: packages-lock.json
nodes.summary: Unity UPM lockfile resolving manifest.json dependencies to concrete versions and hashes. Resolves the BlueOyster git package (hash 808e8ad..., pulling Newtonsoft JSON 3.2.1) and transitive deps such as com.unity.collections, burst, splines, and shadergraph 17.3.0.

edges.description: File defines the abstract TreePlant class.
Awake applies initial tree visuals via OnStateChange.
Each axe hit frightens birds in the tree.
Final axe hit starts the FallTree coroutine.
FallTree asks WillTreeFallEast which side to fall toward.
A landing bird makes the tree shake.
A departing bird makes the tree shake.
OnEnable refreshes the contained renderers on startup.
File defines the nested WoodRackSaveData class.
OnEnable refreshes the rack sprite after seeding.
Defers the all-dry message one frame when the player is awake.
Capacity check before adding a wet log.
Capacity check before adding a dry log.
Cursor interaction removes a dry log.
File defines the nested WoodStoveSaveData class.
OnEnable applies the initial stove state.
Lighting the stove starts the fire sound.
Re-igniting embers starts the fire sound.
Fire dies down to embers, stopping the crackle.
Loading a hot stove restarts the fire sound.
The lockfile pins versions for the dependencies declared in the manifest.
Both belong to the firewood loop — wet logs dried on the rack become fuel for the stove, and WoodStove serializes firewood/dry wood/wet wood inventory items.
